## About

Shubh Orthodontic & Dental Clinic is a premier multi-specialty dental care center in Rohtak, Haryana, India. Founded and led by Prof. Dr. S. K. Yadav (MDS Orthodontics, Ex-PGI Chandigarh, Fellow WFO USA) and Dr. (Prof.) Achla Bharti Yadav (MDS Oral Pathology, Certified Cosmetic Dentist). The clinic has treated over 2,50,000+ patients with a perfect 5.0★ Google rating (300+ verified reviews).
